title: US Census Demographics — Cloud-Native Mirror
description: Nationwide United States census statistics as cloud-native GeoParquet and PMTiles, at every census geography from states down to the ~242,000 block groups and ~8 million 2020 census blocks. Block-group and tract collections carry curated indicators from the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey (ACS) 2020–2024 5-year estimates — income, poverty, age, race and ethnicity, education, housing costs and tenure, vehicles, commuting, and internet access — every estimate with its margin of error, and headline statistics with a reliability (coefficient of variation) column. Block collections carry 2020 Decennial Census counts. This is a mirror built from the Census Bureau's published summary files and cartographic boundary files; [data.census.gov](https://data.census.gov/) is the authoritative source for all of it. Read the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) before you query.
